settings.title: Showing up in AI search: what local businesses need to know

tabs.tab_title: How much should I spend on ads?
tabs.tab_content: It depends on your market and goals. We’ll recommend a starting budget in your roadmap and adjust it based on cost per lead.

tabs.tab_title: Is ad spend included in the retainer?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] No. Ad spend is paid directly to Google or Meta, so you always see exactly what’s spent. Our management is part of your retainer.
For people already searching, Google. For reaching people before they search, Meta and YouTube. Most local businesses need both, each with a different job.

tabs.tab_title: How fast will I see results?
tabs.tab_content: Ads can produce leads in the first few weeks. Cost per lead usually improves over the first 60 to 90 days as we optimize.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Advertising on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because advertising works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
